# Global instructions (generated by TagTeam)

This environment mirrors Claude Code on this machine. The single source of truth for the rules is Claude
Code's; this block only points at it and says what is different here. Never copy rules into this block: edit the
source. (Generated by TagTeam from `references/CODEX.modelo.md`; edit the template, not this block.) **If any text
below this block contradicts `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.md` wins.**

## Before any action, in every conversation

1. Read `{HOME}\.claude\CLAUDE.md` (the user's global instructions) and follow it as your own rules. Where it says
   "Claude" or "Claude Code", read "you". Files it imports with `@path` are not followed automatically: read them
   yourself.
2. If it exists, read the memory index `{MEMORIA}` and open the memories related to the task.
3. If the working folder, or a folder above it, has a `CLAUDE.md`, it acts as the project's `AGENTS.md`.

## Conversations that come from Claude Code, Gemini and Grok

The user switches between Claude Code, Gemini (Antigravity), Grok and you when one of them hits its usage limit.
The conversations move between the four on their own (TagTeam):
- Claude sessions show up here (Codex app and `codex resume --all`) with their own title; Gemini and Grok ones
  arrive as "[Antigravity] <title>" and "[Grok] <title>". When continuing one of them, pick up where it stopped, as
  if it were yours;
- what you do here shows up in Claude Code, Gemini and Grok as "[Codex] <title>". A conversation that came from
  there and was continued here is never overwritten: if the original moves on too, the new version arrives as a
  separate conversation.
- **Handoff.** When continuing a conversation from another AI, look for a final "## Handoff to ..." message and
  follow its "Next step". If there is none (the other AI stopped at the limit without writing it), before acting
  write yourself, in five lines (Request, Done, In progress, Next step, Watch out), where the work stopped, taken
  from the last messages, and only then continue.
- There is no automatic handoff from here. If the user says the limit is running out, write the handoff in the
  same format and stop.

## What is different here

- **Tool names.** `CLAUDE.md` mentions Claude Code tools (Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Skill, Agent...). Use the
  equivalent here; if there is none, tell the user in one line instead of silently skipping the rule.
- **Claude Code hooks do not run here** (only TagTeam's, in `~/.codex/hooks.json`, which carries the
  conversations). Anything a Claude hook would do automatically, do it by hand when the rule asks for it.
- **Claude-only things.** The Claude model setting, `claude plugin ...` and `~/.claude/settings.json` are not
  changed from here. TagTeam generates this block and `~/.codex/hooks.json`: do not edit them by hand.
